outcome.technical: (1) status/audit-lookup.py: compose_writer_prompt still tells the writer to run the tests it adds when a slow gate step is left to the phase gate. A new own_suite_command cuts a slow step that names a tests.add file down to those suites: it keeps the step's runner and flags, keeps the interpreter's script, treats a '-m' module run as having no script, drops every other path, and does not cut a compound command. The line reads 'none declared' only when the gate declares no command; when every declared command is left to the phase gate it says NOTHING_IN_FOREGROUND. (2) governance/run-agent-session.py: invoked_skills returns None when the stream holds no event (empty, or only lines that do not parse), so write_record leaves out skillsInvoked. governance/drive-phase.py: new resumed_session(argv) and session_reading(prior, run, resumed). A resumed round's reading joins the earlier rounds of the SAME session id, taken from the dispatch's --resume word, with its own stream. A fresh dispatch reads its own stream alone. If an earlier round of that session has no reading, the result is unknown, and it says 'not recorded' when a skill is otherwise missing. uninvoked_skills reads 'carried', and note_sessions applies it. I chose union keyed by the resumed session id over 'say nothing': a resumed context IS the session it resumes, so an earlier round's calls are loaded. Keying by round instead would credit a fresh re-dispatch with calls its new context never made, which sk8 pins. (3) status/_impact.py: is_file_name and FILE_NAME_EXTS. A dotted name whose last segment is a file extension is no config key. On the tree (scratch script over every non-suite .py under plugins/audit/scripts and hooks with CONFIG_ROOTS), the only config-shaped term whose last segment is an extension is ci.yml (in _config_rules.py and _panel_settings.py). No leaf key in audit-config.schema.json is an extension word.
